notes.title: Patch 2.0.5 is oUt !
notes.content:
Small but important fixes thanks to the community reports! Keep them coming, we'll never stop to fix!
- Fixed recolored animations not appearing after Steam Deck Update
- Fixed characters remaining colored after being hit by certain endgame attacks
- Fixed crash when closing the game
- Fixed crash when stopping a looped BGS
- Fixed purple door fight

notes.title: Do&De Advanced, releases and SALES!
notes.content:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/361040/
Doom & Destiny Advanced RELEASED!
Doom & Destiny Advanced is a brand new adventure. It's a stand alone game, set in the Doom & Destiny universe. In short, it means that you don’t need to play the first Do&De, but if you did, you’ll enjoy the wacky world and funny characters even more! 

Venture with the most nerdy anti-heroes of all times, face a crazy adventure, defeat a mad business man and save the universe, one fetch quest at a time.
:NigelAdv: :MikeAdv: :JohnnyAdv: :FrancisAdv:

BUNDLE & Destiny!
You can also check the Bundle & Destiny to grab further discount on the newest game, if you already own Doom & Destiny :fsm:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wGeOtBD-8xQ
